name: p2-toy-source-inclusion
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.p2-source-inclusion.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/p2-source-inclusion-commit.txt > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/p2-toy-inclusion.ts p2-fixed-capture p2-fixed-lean/Proofs.lean "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean SourceInclusionControls.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/proof-source-verify.ts" "$OUT/project" "$OUT/lean.log" "$OUT/SOURCE-CHECKED.json" > "$OUT/source-check.log" 2>&1
